description: Map free-text crew role strings (slang, abbreviations, informal titles) to the Soundcheck global position catalog — the same roles returned by list_positions. Handles labels like FOH, A2, sound guy, LD, or stagehand and returns catalog position ids with canonical names/sections; list_positions returns the full catalog. Does not create or write positions; unknown roles are returned as unmapped with fuzzy suggestions.

hint.description: optional event type hint e.g. wedding, festival (max 128 chars)

roles.description: crew role strings to normalize against the catalog (max 64 entries, 128 chars each)

name: normalize_positions

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Normalize crew positions
